issues.concern: The English translation 'pick at' implies a different action than '剥がす' (to peel/tear off). '剥がす' suggests complete removal, while 'pick at' implies a more tentative or partial action.
issues.suggestion: Change 'Please don't pick at the scab on your wound.' to 'Please don't peel off the scab on your wound.' or 'Please don't remove the scab from your wound.'
